title: Some palettes for the IDEM, IDDU, ACEFA, and The Kids
text: Sometimes ggplot2 won’t play nicely fed vector values vector colours used continuous scales. scale_id_continuous allows idpalette arbitrary vector colours converted continuous palette:  wonderful colour scheme
code: library(ggplot2)  ggplot(mtcars) +  geom_point(    aes(      x = disp,      y = hp,      colour = qsec    ),    size = 5  ) +  # usual approach to alter colours:  # scale_fill_continuous(  #   palette = iddu()  # ) # but not allowed: Cannot convert `x` to a continuous palette.  # instead we use `scale_id_continuous`:  scale_id_continuous(    cols = iddu(),    aesthetics = "colour"  ) my_wonderful_colour_scheme <- c("brown4", "magenta", "grey80", "salmon", "gold")  ggplot(mtcars) +  geom_point(    aes(      x = disp,      y = hp,      colour = qsec    ),    size = 5  ) +  scale_id_continuous(    cols = my_wonderful_colour_scheme,    aesthetics = "colour"  )

code: library(ggplot2)  ggplot(   faithfuld,    aes(waiting, eruptions) ) +  geom_raster(    aes(fill = density)  ) +   scale_fill_gradientn(     colours = idpalette("iddu", 100)   ) ggplot(mpg) +   geom_bar(     aes(       x = trans,       fill = class     )   ) +   scale_fill_manual(values = idem()) +   theme_bw() library(sdmtools) library(terra) #> terra 1.8.60  r <- example_raster(seed = 20240802)  par(mfcol = c(1, 2))  plot(   r,   col = thekids(100) )  plot(   r,   col = thekids(100, rev = TRUE) )

"_official" includes black white, "_diverging" includes white, excludes dark teal, midnight blue, black, use diverging colour schemes (duh) NB: additional IDEM, IDDU 'non-official' colours estimated colour dropper thing Gerry found internet may may exactly correct.
